title: apply versus save prefer autosave
name: Apply versus save prefer autosave — Fluent
rule: Apply versus Save; prefer autosave; if not, Save + success/error via message bar or confirmation toast.
pass_when: Apply vs Save is used for the right scope; autosave is preferred; without autosave, Save reports success/error via message bar or confirmation toast.
fail_when: Apply/Save mixed up; no autosave and no success/error after Save.
overview: Prefer autosave; otherwise Save reports success or error after the commit.
apply_when: Choosing Apply versus Save and feedback after edits in Fluent settings.
not_when: Transient Message-only important failures — use dialog guidance instead.
agent_hint: Prefer autosave; if Save, confirm success or error via message bar or toast.
description: Fluent distinguishes Apply versus Save by scope and prefers autosave so users are not left wondering whether edits stuck. Without autosave, Save must report success or error through a message bar or confirmation toast after the commit. Apply when choosing save patterns in Fluent settings and editors. Fail mixing Apply and Save scopes, or a Save path with neither autosave nor success/error feedback after the action.
do_not_claim: Disabled-until-complete as this row (that lock lives on `govuk.dont-use-disabled-buttons` + `fluent.disabled-field-label-stays-perceivable`); `actions.close_saves_separate_cancel` as a merge.
